text:
Jesus said: “Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.” Matthew 11:28

No cleaning yourself up first. Just come.

If you are tired today, tell Him in one honest sentence. He is gentle and humble in heart.

“Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.” Philippians 4:6

Pick one worry. Turn it into a one-line prayer right now.

Reply 🙏 when you have, and we will pray for you today.

“Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.” Romans 12:2

What you feed your mind all day, you become.

Today: before you open any app, open the Word. Five minutes. Let it set your mind first.

“For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.” Mark 10:45

Greatness in the Kingdom looks like a towel and a basin.

One quiet act of service today, done for Him. Who comes to mind?

“Let us consider how to spur one another on to love and good deeds. Let us not neglect meeting together.” Hebrews 10:24-25

Faith was never meant to be lived alone.

Text one believer today: “How can I pray for you?”

“I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me.” Galatians 2:20

The flesh doesn't get managed. It gets put to death, daily, by the life of Christ in you.

“Walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.” Galatians 5:16

“Be still and know that I am God.” Psalm 46:10

Sunday. Put the phone down after this. Sit with one verse and let Him speak.
